features.ip_note: Product withdrawn: live autocomputer.ai is a holding page only (no product, API, pricing or docs). Historically (2025) it was an AI-RPA service; its Python SDK (autocomputer-sdk 0.9.0, last push 2025-11-11) provisioned remote computers via E2B (Linux) or RDP/WinRM (Windows) through api.autocomputer.ai, which no longer responds. No browser endpoint or proxy offering. Site sits behind a Vercel JS checkpoint (passable with a rendered browser).

caveats: No product is offered on autocomputer.ai as of 2026-09-29: the live site is a one-paragraph holding page ('We build autonomous AI systems to do long-horizon tasks on computers and the internet.') plus stub legal pages; /pricing and /api return 404 and api.autocomputer.ai does not accept connections. The earlier RPA product (Wayback 2025-06: Business 'starting from $999/month', 'Up to 100 instances'; Enterprise custom, 'Up to 1000 instances'; API in 'Developer beta') was withdrawn by 2025-11 ('Coming soon.'). The company now appears to ship RemoteMux (docs.remotemux.com), a different product (persistent remote coding-agent workspaces), not Windows cloud computers. Treat as discontinued; do not price.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.
